annotations.title: Change a connection's reading, note, or dates

description: Edits an existing edge between two pages: its `kind` (how the two relate), its `note`, and/or when it was true (`validFrom` / `validTo`). Use kind to CORRECT a connection typed wrongly — 'Dana doesn't own billing, she's involved in it'. Use validTo to END one that used to be true — 'Dana handed approvals to Sam in March' ends Dana's edge in March (then create Sam's from March); the old edge stays as history. Don't delete a relationship that ended; end it. Link ids come from compass_page_links_list. Fails with conflict when the new reading already exists between the same two pages (delete this one instead). May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response, after the user has approved. Omit on the first call.

kind.description: New edge type, in canonical direction.

note.description: New qualifier note (≤500 chars); empty string clears it.

validFrom.description: When it started being true (YYYY-MM-DD); null clears it.

validTo.description: When it stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD) — ends the relationship; null reopens it.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_links_update
